title: Site hosting options: Amplify static WEB, proven on pilobil.us
description:
## Goal

Hosting is a **Papyrus site configuration option**, not a per-publication fork.

Pilobol.us is the first publication that *uses* the static option. It is not a special Papyrus checkout, not a second product repo in the Threat Intelligence shape (`github.com/anthusai/threat-intelligence` + its own Amplify `WEB_COMPUTE` app), and not a one-off README in the pod.

## Axes (do not collapse them)

Already decided: Renderer (`pretext` | `markus`) × Layout (Pretext-only: `newsprint` | `blog` | `magazine`) × Publication (the title).

Add **Hosting** as a sibling axis, documented in Papyrus:

```text
type HostingConfig =
  | { kind: "amplify-ssr" }      // Amplify platform WEB_COMPUTE. Next.js. GraphQL at request time. Content can change without rebuilding HTML.
  | { kind: "amplify-static" }   // Amplify platform WEB. Build emits a folder of HTML/CSS/assets. New copy = new build.
```

Leave the union open for later kinds (GitHub Pages, S3+CloudFront) without implementing them. Invalid combos can exist in theory (pretext + static is a poor fit today); document the intended pairings rather than inventing a fake static Pretext pipeline.

Intended pairings:
- **amplify-ssr** + pretext — p.apyr.us / Threat Intelligence today
- **amplify-static** + markus — pilobol.us, and any future Markus publication

## Domain (decided — do not relitigate)

The public domain is **pilobol.us** (publication **Pilobol.us**, git repo `AnthusAI/Pilobol.us`).

`pilobil.us` was a typo (including in `Pilobol.us/doctrine/pilobil.md`). Do not create a `pilobil.us` hosted zone. Fix that typo in doctrine/docs as part of this work where you touch them.

## Papyrus deliverable (this is the point)

Document the option **in the Papyrus repo**, not only in the pod:

- A runnable hosting doc under `docs/` (new file, e.g. `docs/site-hosting.md`) that explains both kinds, when to choose which, Amplify platform values (`WEB` vs `WEB_COMPUTE`), what the build artifact is, custom domains / Route 53, and how a new publication opts in.
- A pointer from `AGENTS.md` so agents do not cargo-cult the SSR `amplify.yml` onto a Markus site.
- Any committed config/examples (sample `amplify.yml` for the static kind, env vars) live in Papyrus as the template. The publication repo consumes that pattern; it does not invent a private one.

Do **not** edit `lib/site-brand.ts` / renderer dispatch in this issue if PPY-eca592 / PPY-a10206 are still in flight on those files. Record the intended `HostingConfig` shape in the doc so eca592 can absorb it as a sibling of `RendererConfig` rather than a second independent enum. Do not add a required-but-ignored field.

## Pilobol.us is the proof, not the product

1. Create Route 53 public hosted zone **pilobol.us**. Comment NS records here for Ryan. Do this first so propagation runs in parallel.
2. Stand up Amplify Hosting **platform `WEB`** using the Papyrus-documented static pattern. Build = Markus static output (`web/dist` or the Papyrus-defined equivalent). Not `WEB_COMPUTE`, not `ampx pipeline-deploy`, not the Papyrus app `dbsyytcm9drqa`.
3. Attach `pilobol.us` + `www` once the zone exists. Amplify default domain is acceptable until NS propagate.
4. CI builds from repo-committed Markdown with `markus convert --allow-html` off.

## Constraints

- Do not fork Papyrus. Do not create a publication-specific Papyrus GitHub repo.
- Do not deploy to or modify p.apyr.us production.
- Do not touch `lib/renderer.ts` or `renderers/pretext/`.
- Record teardown for anything that is not the lasting hosted zone / production static app.
- Do not close this issue yourself.

## Acceptance

- Papyrus `docs/` (+ AGENTS.md pointer) describes hosting kinds so a later publication can choose `amplify-static` without copying Pilobol by folklore.
- Hosted zone exists for **pilobol.us**; NS records are in a Kanbus comment.
- A push publishes Markus HTML to a reachable URL via the documented static option.
- After Ryan sets nameservers, `https://pilobol.us` serves that site.

comments.text:
## Plan (Composer 2.5 planner — NOT authorized to implement)

### Worktrees & branches (manager must verify before authorize)
| Repo | Worktree path | Branch |
|------|---------------|--------|
| Papyrus (docs/templates) | `/Users/home/Projects/Papyrus-worktrees/PPY-17fcfc-site-hosting` | `cursor/feature/PPY-17fcfc-site-hosting-3af6` |
| Pilobol.us (deploy) | `/Users/home/Projects/Pilobol.us-worktrees/PPY-17fcfc-static-hosting` | `cursor/feature/PPY-17fcfc-amplify-static-3af6` |

Branch both from `origin/develop` (Papyrus) and `origin/main` (Pilobol.us). Never code in primary clones (`/Users/home/Projects/Papyrus`, `/Users/home/Projects/Pilobol.us`).

### Papyrus deliverables (docs + templates only)
- `docs/site-hosting.md` — Hosting as sibling axis (Renderer × Layout × Publication × **Hosting**); document `HostingConfig` union (`amplify-ssr` | `amplify-static`, open for future kinds); WEB vs WEB_COMPUTE; artifact models; intended pairings (ssr+pretext, static+markus); Route 53/custom domains; how a publication opts in; anti-patterns (TI fork, cargo-cult SSR yml, pod-only docs).
- `docs/hosting/amplify-static.yml.example` — Minimal WEB-platform build spec (Python `web/build.py`, artifact `web/dist`).
- `docs/hosting/amplify-ssr.yml.example` — Pointer-only to root `amplify.yml` pattern (WEB_COMPUTE + `ampx pipeline-deploy` + `.next`); not for Markus pods.
- `AGENTS.md` — Short pointer + explicit warning: do not copy Papyrus SSR `amplify.yml` onto Markus static sites.
- PR → `develop`. **No** `lib/site-brand.ts`, **no** `lib/renderer.ts`, **no** renderer code.

### Pilobol.us proof (consume PPY-5e8072 leftover)
- **Recover** uncommitted `web/` from primary clone via `rsync -a` into worktree only; do not `git add` in primary clone.
- Add `web/dist/` to `.gitignore`; CI builds HTML from `content/` + `build.py`.
- Add repo-root `amplify.yml` matching Papyrus static template; pin `markus` install for Amplify (PyPI or git ref — document cross-repo hazard).
- `build.py` already uses `markus convert --fragment --no-css` (no `--allow-html`).
- PR → `main`; connect new Amplify app to this repo.

### AWS steps (strict order)
1. Read `AGENTS.local.md` preflight.
2. **Route 53 first:** create public hosted zone `pilobil.us` (doctrine spelling; repo is Pilobol.us).
3. **Kanbus comment NS records for Ryan** (parallel propagation).
4. Create **new** Amplify Hosting app, platform **WEB** (not WEB_COMPUTE), **not** `dbsyytcm9drqa` / p.apyr.us.
5. Connect `AnthusAI/Pilobol.us`, branch `main`, use repo `amplify.yml`.
6. Verify deploy on Amplify default domain (`*.amplifyapp.com`).
7. Attach custom domains `pilobil.us` + `www.pilobil.us` (Amplify creates alias records in the zone).
8. After Ryan sets registrar NS → verify `https://pilobil.us`.

**Amplify WEB settings:** artifact `web/dist`; build `cd web && python3 build.py`; preBuild installs `markus`; no backend phase; no `ampx pipeline-deploy`; no Next.js.

### Out of scope
HostingConfig TypeScript (PPY-eca592); Pretext static; p.apyr.us; renderer files; redoing PPY-5e8072 design; GitHub Pages/S3 (mention only); closing this issue.

### Acceptance
- Papyrus docs + AGENTS pointer merged to develop.
- Zone exists; NS commented here.
- Git push publishes Markus HTML to reachable URL (default domain before NS; `https://pilobil.us` after).
- Forbidden paths untouched; no TI-style Papyrus fork.

### Inversion failures
TI fork (separate Papyrus repo + WEB_COMPUTE); docs only in pod; SSR `amplify.yml` on Markus; editing `site-brand.ts` during eca592; domain typo `pilobol.us` vs `pilobil.us`.

Awaiting manager approval before implementation.
